gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-osage: Noto Sans Osage fills the line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves that never quite close up. Conthrax, all smooth geometry, gives it a sharp contrast.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Clean and geometric, Conthrax draws its horizontals as heavy as its verticals, like a single thread. Noto Sans Osmanya follows in a plain sans, its wide-turning s shapes carrying a long stretch of text without any strain.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-: Conthrax runs a smooth drawn-wire feel through every word, wide-mouthed and geometric. And Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, with its high-set x-height and gapped rounds, would look oversized if you made the heading small.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-palmyre: Conthrax has tall-bodied lowercase that leaves its capitals barely taller, and no brush-like swelling anywhere in its strokes. Noto Sans Palmyrene reads steadily, its curves stopping short of closing.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin: Modern and clean, Conthrax fattens its crossbars to match its stems, wide-mouthed and geometric. And Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau, with open-ended curves, is the real strength here: a body that lets everything breathe.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Approachable and contemporary, Noto Sans PhagsPa lets you see through its c openings under Conthrax, whose round letters have rims matching their stems. Over a longer passage it moves along gently, rising only slightly into capitals.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-phoenic: Think bent paperclips: Conthrax is wide, geometric and utterly free of thick-thin shifts. Noto Sans Phoenician steps in with generous lowercase height and s curves open at both ends, so the two sit together easily.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-psalter: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi gapes wide on its e and barely lifts its capitals. Conthrax is best at bold, uniform geometry with no thick-thin variation, while the body font is best at approachable, easygoing text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang opens its lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, with distinct gaps in c, e, s and a. Conthrax holds a calm, unvarying weight from word to word, and Noto Sans Rejang gives that steadiness some visible air.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-runic: Neutral and modern, Noto Sans Runic carries a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves. And Conthrax, with strokes that look traced by marker, gives that openness a firm geometric lead.
